items.source: Always returns false since Jaxb2CollectionHttpMessageConverter does not convert collections to XML.
items.translation: 始终返回false，因为 Jaxb2CollectionHttpMessageConverter 不会将集合转换为 XML。

items.source: Jaxb2CollectionHttpMessageConverter can read a generic Collection where the generic type is a JAXB type annotated with XmlRootElement or XmlType.
items.translation: Jaxb2CollectionHttpMessageConverter 可以读取泛型Collection，其中泛型类型是带有XmlRootElement或XmlType注解的 JAXB 类型。

items.source: This converter can read collections that contain classes annotated with XmlRootElement and XmlType. Note that this converter does not support writing.
items.translation: 此转换器可以读取包含用 `XmlRootElement` 和 `XmlType` 注解的类的集合。请注意，此转换器不支持写入。

items.source:
Can be overridden in subclasses, adding further initialization of the factory.
The resulting factory is cached, so this method will only be called once.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写，以添加工厂的进一步初始化。生成的工厂会被缓存，因此此方法仅会被调用一次。

items.source: contentType - the content type to use when writing. May be null to indicate that the default content type of the converter must be used. If not null, this media type must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: `contentType` - 写入时使用的内容类型。可为 `null`，以指示必须使用转换器的默认内容类型。如果非 `null`，则此媒体类型必须已先前传递给该接口的 canWrite 方法，且该方法必须返回 `true`。

items.source: type - the (potentially generic) type of object to write. This type must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true. Can be null if not specified.

items.source: t - the object to write to the output message. The type of this object must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true.
